panel.auth.accountPlaceholder: Filled in once the token is validated
panel.auth.accountReady: Token saved, the repository list can be loaded directly.
panel.auth.baseUrlHelp: Leave empty for the official site; fill in the root URL for a self-hosted GitLab / Gitee.
panel.auth.notice: The access token is stored encrypted in the plugin's private data folder only. It is never written into the memory folder and never appears in the logs.
panel.auth.providerHelp: Pick a provider, then create an access token as described below.
panel.auth.title: Account and remote repository
panel.auth.tokenHelp: The token validates the account once and is then used to list repositories and push changes.
panel.auth.tokenPlaceholderSet: Enter a new token to replace the saved one
panel.confirm.connect.message: This sets {target} as the remote of the memory repository and syncs once. Continue?
panel.confirm.connect.title: Link remote repository

panel.confirm.create.title: Create private repository
panel.confirm.disconnect.message: This removes the remote from the memory repository; local files and commit history are kept. Continue?
panel.confirm.disconnect.title: Remove remote link
panel.confirm.init.message: This runs git init inside the memory folder, writes .gitignore and saves the commit identity settings. Continue?
panel.confirm.init.title: Initialize memory repository
panel.confirm.token.message: This deletes the token stored in the plugin's private folder. The linked remote is not changed.

panel.git.missingAlert: No usable Git was found, so auto sync and manual sync are skipped. Install Git first and then click "Re-check".
panel.git.title: Git environment
panel.install.afterInstall: After installing or updating Git, restart N.E.K.O so the new PATH takes effect, then re-check here.
panel.install.intro: Git Memory Sync relies on the local Git command line. Install Git with one of the options below, then come back and click "Re-check".
panel.install.title: Git was not found
panel.repo.head: Latest commit
panel.repo.newDescriptionHelp: Optional, only used for the remote repository description.
panel.repo.newNameHelp: Creates a private repository with this name and links it as the remote.
panel.repo.notInitialized: The memory folder is not a Git repository yet, click "Initialize repository" first.
panel.repo.queryHelp: Leave empty to load the most recently updated repositories.
panel.repo.selectFirst: Load and pick a repository, or type one to link.
panel.repo.title: Memory repository
panel.repo.warning: Creating a repository needs a token with repository-creation permission; the repository is private by default so memory content stays private.
panel.settings.authorEmailHelp: Leave empty to use the global Git configuration.
panel.settings.authorNameHelp: Leave empty to use the global Git configuration.
panel.settings.branchHelp: Branch used for syncing, main is recommended.
panel.settings.gitignoreExtraHelp: One rule per line, applied on the next sync after saving.
panel.settings.gitignorePresetHelp: Ignore rules written into the memory folder when the repository is initialized.
panel.settings.gitignorePreviewHelp: These are the ignore rules generated by the saved settings.
panel.settings.notify: Notify me when auto sync fails
panel.settings.proxyHelp: Used when the proxy mode is manual, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890.
panel.settings.proxyModeHelp: git ignores the Windows/macOS system proxy, so the default is automatic: the manual address first, then the app's environment variables, then the OS proxy. N.E.K.O's direct-connection switch is honoured too.
panel.settings.remotePolicyHelp: What to do when the remote has commits the local copy does not: the panel asks you by default, or you can always keep one side.
panel.settings.title: Git settings
panel.subtitle: Back up and sync the memory folder to a private GitHub / GitLab / Gitee repository
panel.sync.detailHelp: Raw git output from the last failed sync (tokens redacted): use it to tell DNS, certificate, proxy and permission failures apart.
panel.sync.intervalHelp: Once enabled the plugin commits and pushes memory changes on this interval.
panel.sync.pending.detail: The remote {branch} branch has {behind} commit(s) the local copy does not (local is {ahead} ahead). Choose which version to keep:
panel.sync.pending.keepLocalNote: Keeping the local version force-pushes your commits and overwrites commits other people pushed.
panel.sync.pending.keepRemoteNote: Keeping the remote version overwrites the local memory directory; unpushed local commits are discarded.
panel.sync.pending.summary: The remote is {behind} commit(s) ahead and the local copy is {ahead} ahead. Choose which version to keep: keeping the remote overwrites the local memory, keeping the local overwrites the remote repository.
panel.sync.pending.title: The remote repository has a newer version
panel.sync.remoteRequired: No remote repository is linked yet: pick or create a private repository under "Account and repository" below, then sync.
panel.sync.tip: While the plugin runs, auto sync checks every minute whether it is due; manual and auto sync share one lock, so only one sync task runs at a time.
panel.sync.title: Sync settings
panel.title: Git Memory Sync
panel.toast.connected: Remote repository linked and synced once.
panel.toast.created: Private repository created and linked to the memory folder.
panel.toast.initialized: The memory folder is now a Git repository.
panel.toast.interval: Auto sync interval set to {minutes} minutes.
panel.toast.keepLocal: The remote repository now matches the local version.
panel.toast.keepRemote: The local memory now matches the remote version.
plugin.description: Uses GitPython to sync N.E.K.O's memory folder to a private GitHub / GitLab / Gitee repository, with scheduled and manual sync.
plugin.name: Git Memory Sync
plugin.short_description: Back up and sync the memory folder to a private GitHub / GitLab / Gitee repository with Git.
